node.statement: In every exact-unit epsilon_r-C*-algebra one has epsilon_r >= 0: applying the product-norm axiom to J bold-dot J = J and ||J|| = 1 yields 1 <= 1+epsilon_r. Hence A := q+epsilon_r*q+q^2 and B := epsilon_r*delta+delta^2 are nonnegative because q in [0,1] and delta > 0.
